newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian T-bills to trade on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Russian T-bills to trade on Wednesday.

text.p: Secondary market trading in government securities will take place on Wednesday afternoon after the auctions of T-bills and government bonds, a central bank official said.

Normally there is no secondary market trading on days when auctions are held -- usually Wednesdays. But markets will be closed on Thursday and Friday this week for holidays marking the anniversary of the 1917 revolution.

Alexei Drugov, head of the central bank's capital markets operations division, told Reuters the auction of six-month T-bills (series 22057) would take place from 11 a.m. to 11.45 a.m. (0800-0845 GMT) and the auction of a new tranche of the two-year bond maturing March 1998 (series 24007) will be held from 1.30 p.m. to 2.15 p.m. (1030-1115 GMT).
Results of the auctions should be available by 3 p.m. (1200 GMT) with an hour of trading from 3.30 p.m. to 4.30 p.m. (1230-1330 GMT), if the auctions run on time, he said.
